```{=html}
<!-- LAYOUT A (the page at tools/backing-track.qmd): by task. The transport is a bar fixed to the foot of the window, as on the lesson pages (PlayBar, apps/shared/playbar.js),
     the chart is at the top, and everything else is on tabs, one at a time. The Mixer tab is a console: a strip for each part and each kit fader, with the EQ beside them. See _bt-draft-common.qmd. -->
<style>
/* in the bar (and in its Options panel) a control's name sits beside it, as on the lesson pages */
#bt-root.dxa :is(.playbar,.playbar-pop) .bt-field{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:.4rem}
#bt-root.dxa :is(.playbar,.playbar-pop) :is(select,input[type=number]){height:1.9rem;font-size:.85rem;padding:0 .35rem}
#bt-root.dxa :is(.playbar,.playbar-pop) select{max-width:13rem}
#bt-root.dxa :is(.playbar,.playbar-pop) .bt-btn{height:1.9rem;padding:0 .7rem;font-size:.85rem}
#bt-root.dxa .playbar>*{flex:0 0 auto}
#bt-root.dxa .playbar .bt-play{height:2.3rem;min-width:6.5rem;flex:0 0 auto}
#bt-root.dxa .playbar .bt-beats{height:auto}
#bt-root.dxa :is(.playbar,.playbar-pop) .bt-status{margin:0;min-height:0;width:9.5rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-loopnote:empty{display:none}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-loopnote{margin:0 0 .5rem}
#bt-root.dxa #bt-sec-tools{flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:.6rem}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.25rem;margin-top:1rem;border-bottom:2px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce)}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-tabs button{padding:.4rem .9rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-bottom:0;border-radius:7px 7px 0 0;background:var(--site-surface-2,#f2ede5);
  color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--site-accent-text,#0a4f47);border-color:var(--site-accent-text,#0a4f47);color:#fff}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-pane>.bt-panel{margin-top:.6rem}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-pane>details.bt-panel>summary{display:none}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-pane .bt-row2{margin-top:0;padding-top:0;border-top:0}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-pane>.bt-about{margin:.8rem 0 0}
/* the Band tab: a card for each player. Bass over drums on the left, the chord player beside them, a second chord player beside that */
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:.8rem;align-items:start}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-band>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.8rem;min-width:0}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-band .bt-sub,#bt-root.dxa .dxa-whole{margin:0;padding:.7rem .8rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-radius:8px}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-whole{margin-top:.8rem}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-band .bt-row{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:.5rem}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-band select,#bt-root.dxa .dxa-band input[type=range]{width:100%;max-width:100%}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-band .bt-morelist{grid-template-columns:1fr}
@media (max-width:900px){ #bt-root.dxa .dxa-band{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)} }
/* the console */
/* Three blocks side by side, each a heading, one line of menus (the same height in all three, empty for the band) and its faders, so the
   faders line up across the page. The blocks keep their widths whatever is chosen: the band's has room for the second chord player. */
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-console{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem 1.6rem;align-items:flex-start}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-console>*{min-width:0;max-width:100%;flex:0 0 auto}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-console .dx-ctl{display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:flex-end;gap:.4rem .6rem;height:3.5rem;margin:0 0 .6rem}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-console .dx-strips{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;max-width:100%}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-parts{width:calc(5 * 3.75rem + 4 * .3rem)}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-parts div.dx-strip{flex:0 0 3.75rem}
#bt-root.dxa #bt-eq-inst{width:14rem}
/* under them, across the whole width: the amp of the instrument on show in the EQ, then the organ's panel */
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-amp,#bt-root.dxa #bt-organ{margin-top:1rem;padding-top:.8rem;border-top:1px solid var(--site-border-soft,#ece6dc)}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-amp #bt-amp-stages{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(12rem,1fr));margin-top:.5rem}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-amp .bt-hint{margin:0}
#bt-root.dxa .dxa-amp .bt-row{margin:0}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  var D = window.BTDraft, $ = D.$, el = D.el;
  if (!D || !D.player) return;                                          // (the band did not load: the page says so itself)
  var root = D.init("dxa", "", [["backing-track-classic.html", "the earlier layout"], ["backing-track-b.html", "draft B"]]);
  var top = root.querySelector(".bt-panel"), rows = top.querySelectorAll(":scope > .bt-row"), about = root.querySelector("details.bt-about"), abcBox = root.querySelector("details.bt-abc");
  // ---- the bar at the foot of the window: everything the Play panel held, in one row. [element, importance, importance while playing]:
  // the higher the number the sooner it leaves the bar for the Options panel when the window is narrow. Play never leaves.
  var foot = el("div"), F = D.field; foot.id = "dxa-bar";
  [[$("bt-play")], [$("bt-beats"), 5, 3], [F("bt-fill"), 7, 1], [$("bt-sections-field"), 6, 2], [F("bt-tempo-n"), 1, 4], [F("bt-key"), 2, 6], [F("bt-style"), 3, 7], [F("bt-meter"), 8, 8], [$("bt-pace-f"), 8, 5],
   [F("bt-changes"), 9, 9], [$("bt-status"), 4, 3]].forEach(function(x){ if (x.length > 1){ x[0].setAttribute("data-pri", x[1]); x[0].setAttribute("data-pri-live", x[2]); } foot.appendChild(x[0]); });
  root.appendChild(foot);
  // two notes that are sentences, not controls: the loop's goes over the chart, the section's (with its two buttons) to the top of the Band tab
  $("bt-loop-note").classList.add("dxa-loopnote"); root.insertBefore($("bt-loop-note"), $("bt-chartrow"));
  $("bt-sec-band").insertBefore($("bt-sec-tools"), $("bt-sec-band").querySelector("summary").nextSibling);

  // ---- the tabs: [id, label, the blocks it shows] ----
  var playBox = el("div", "bt-panel"); playBox.appendChild(rows[1]);
  var TABS = [["play", "Play", [playBox, $("bt-practice")]], ["band", "Band", [$("bt-sec-band")]], ["mix", "Mixer", [$("bt-sec-mix")]],
              ["chart", "Chart and changes", [$("bt-sec-chart"), abcBox]], ["notation", "Notation", [$("bt-notation")]], ["melody", "Melody", [$("bt-melody")]], ["files", "Save and export", [$("bt-setups"), $("bt-export"), about]]];
  var bar = el("div", "dxa-tabs"), panes = el("div", "dxa-panes"), KEY = "btDraftATab", cur = "band";
  bar.setAttribute("role", "tablist");
  TABS.forEach(function(t){
    var b = el("button", "", t[1]), pane = el("div", "dxa-pane"); b.type = "button"; b.id = "dxa-tab-" + t[0]; b.setAttribute("role", "tab"); b.setAttribute("aria-controls", "dxa-pane-" + t[0]);
    pane.id = "dxa-pane-" + t[0]; pane.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel"); pane.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", b.id);
    t[2].forEach(function(node){ var s = node.matches("details.bt-panel") ? node.querySelector(":scope > summary") : null;
      if (s && t[2].length > 1) node.insertBefore(D.head(s.textContent.trim()), s.nextSibling);          // (a tab of several blocks keeps their names)
      pane.appendChild(node); });
    b.addEventListener("click", function(){ show(t[0]); });
    b.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){ var d = e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 0; if (!d) return;
      var i = (TABS.indexOf(t) + d + TABS.length) % TABS.length; show(TABS[i][0]); $("dxa-tab-" + TABS[i][0]).focus(); });
    t.push(b, pane); bar.appendChild(b); panes.appendChild(pane);
  });
  root.appendChild(bar); root.appendChild(panes);
  // A tab's panels are open while it shows and closed otherwise, so the Notation panel only draws (and the band only writes ahead) on its tab.
  function show(id){
    if (!TABS.some(function(t){ return t[0] === id; })) id = "band"; cur = id;
    TABS.forEach(function(t){ var on = t[0] === id; t[3].setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on)); t[3].tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; t[4].hidden = !on;
      t[2].forEach(function(node){ if (node.matches("details.bt-panel")) node.open = on; }); });
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, id); } catch (e) {}
  }

  // ---- the Band tab: bass over drums and congas | chords | second chords, and what belongs to the whole band under them ----
  (function(){
    var band = $("bt-sec-band"), subs = band.querySelectorAll(":scope > .bt-sub"), cols = el("div", "dxa-band"), a = el("div"), b = el("div"), c = el("div"), second = el("div", "bt-sub");
    second.appendChild(el("h3", "", "Second chords")); second.appendChild($("bt-second-row"));
    D.put(a, subs[1], subs[3], subs[4]); b.appendChild(subs[2]); c.appendChild(second); D.put(cols, a, b, c);
    band.insertBefore(cols, subs[0]); subs[0].classList.add("dxa-whole");
  })();

  // ---- the Mixer tab: parts | kit | EQ, then the amp and the organ ----
  var mix = $("bt-sec-mix"), cons = el("div", "dxa-console"), parts = el("div"), faders = mix.querySelector(".bt-mixer");
  faders.classList.add("dx-strips");
  parts.className = "dxa-parts"; D.put(parts, D.head("Band"), el("div", "dx-ctl"), faders);
  $("bt-kit").querySelector(".bt-row").classList.add("dx-ctl"); $("bt-eq").querySelector(".bt-row").classList.add("dx-ctl");
  var amp = el("div", "dxa-amp"); D.put(amp, $("bt-amp-none"), $("bt-amp"));
  $("bt-kit").insertBefore(D.head("Drum kit"), $("bt-kit").firstChild);
  $("bt-eq").insertBefore(D.head("Tone (EQ)"), $("bt-eq").firstChild);
  D.put(cons, parts, $("bt-kit"), $("bt-eq")); mix.insertBefore(cons, mix.querySelector("summary").nextSibling);
  mix.appendChild(amp); mix.appendChild($("bt-organ"));
  D.partStrips(true); D.kitStrips(); D.eq(); D.amp();

  var saved = null; try { saved = localStorage.getItem(KEY); } catch (e) {}
  show(saved || "band");
  top.hidden = true;                                                    // (the emptied Play panel)
  PlayBar.attach(foot, { live: function(){ return $("bt-play").getAttribute("data-state") === "playing"; } });
})();
</script>
```
